judgement.reason: The outcome already requires repository changes, since the Dockerfile downloads a released tarball instead of building this source and runs supervisord, and a contained Dockerfile rewrite fixes both.

reviews.findingEvidence: Unsupported container setup: .docker/Dockerfile runs supervisord with a web server and a worker program (.docker/config/supervisord.conf) in one container. Deployz runs one web process and declared workers as separate services.
reviews.reason: The production image runs supervisord with php-fpm, nginx and a scheduler worker in one container, which Deployz would need to split into a web service and a separate worker.

reviews.findingEvidence: Unconfirmed service: the repository declares leantime_db (mysql:8.4) in .docker/docker-compose.yml; mariadb (a Helm dependency) in helm/Chart.yaml. Deployz did not find how the application uses it.
reviews.reason: The declared services are MySQL (mysql:8.4) and MariaDB, a MySQL-compatible database that a Helm setting can turn off, and Deployz already provides managed MySQL for this app.
